results.snippet: While EU officials have previously advised telcos to avoid partnering with "high-risk vendors" (a.k.a. Huawei) for their 5G networks, things are changing fast. The EU might update its CSA (Cybersecurity Act) in a way that makes avoiding Huawei hardware and software altogether (not just from a network's core) a mandatory requirement.
